intents.hardship: Financial hardship: job loss, illness, cannot cover essentials.
intents.dispute: "This isn't my debt" or "I never had that product".
intents.restructure: A request for a payment plan or lower instalments.
intents.too_much: The customer says the full amount is too much.

lines.opening: Hello, this is Isla, a digital assistant calling from Glenmorrow Savings Bank. We record this call.
lines.robot: I'm Isla, a digital assistant calling from Glenmorrow Savings Bank.
lines.scam: I understand your concern. You can always call Glenmorrow Savings Bank on the number shown in your online banking and ask to be put through.
lines.purpose_before_verify: I can tell you once we've completed a quick security check.
lines.no_info: I'm sorry, I don't have that information.
lines.not_talk_once: I understand. This will only take a few minutes.
lines.tp_ask: When would be a good time to reach {title} {last_name}?
lines.tp_outside_window: I'm sorry, we can only call back today or on the next two business days, between 9 am and 6:30 pm. Is there another time that would work?
lines.tp_no_info: I'm sorry, I can only discuss this with {title} {last_name}.
lines.tp_booked: Thank you. We will call back on {date} at {time}.
lines.wrong_number: I'm sorry to have troubled you. Thank you for letting me know.
lines.condolence: I'm very sorry for your loss.
lines.id_intro: Before we go on, I need to ask you two security questions.
lines.id_why: We ask these questions to protect your information and make sure we are speaking with the right person.
lines.id_explain: The questions keep your details safe, and I can't continue without them.
lines.id_declined: I understand, but I can't continue without confirming your identity.
lines.id_repeat: Sorry, could you repeat that, please?
lines.id_wrong: I'm sorry, that doesn't match our records.
lines.id_failed: I'm sorry, I can't confirm your identity on this call. Please visit a branch or use online banking.
lines.disclose_intro: Thank you. I'm calling because some payments on your account are overdue.
lines.product_line: Your {name} has {amount} in arrears, and it is {days} days overdue.
lines.ask_today: Can you pay the full {amount} today?
lines.ask_today_multi: Can you pay both in full today?
lines.offer_floor_date: I understand. Could you pay {amount} on {date}?
lines.below_floor: I'm sorry, I can't record less than {floor}. Could you pay {floor}?
lines.below_floor_again: I'm sorry, that is still below the minimum I can accept.
lines.date_past: I'm sorry, that date has already passed. Which date from today onwards would work for you?
lines.not_business_day: That day isn't a business day. The next business day is {date}. Would that work?
lines.after_deadline: I'm sorry, the latest date I can accept is {date}. Could you pay by then?
lines.vague_ask: Which exact day would that be?
lines.ask_date_for_amount: On which date could you pay {amount}?
lines.repeat_offer: Just to repeat, could you pay {amount} on {date}?
lines.readback_intro: Let me read back what we agreed.
lines.clamped_note: For your {name}, the latest date I can accept is {deadline}, so I've used that date.
lines.recorded: Thank you, your promise has been recorded.
lines.record_failed: I'm sorry, the promise for your {name} could not be recorded.
lines.paid_line: Thank you. Payments can take two business days to show, so I won't ask you for a payment on this one.
lines.dispute_line: I understand. I won't ask you for a payment on this one, and the bank will look into it.
lines.hardship: I'm very sorry to hear you're going through this. I'm passing you to our care team, who can help.
lines.hardship_short: Is that all right with you?
lines.restructure_line: I'll put you through to our arrears solutions team, who can talk with you about payment plans.
lines.human_ask_help: I may be able to help you with that myself. Would you like me to try?
lines.transfer: Please hold while I transfer you.
lines.anything_else: Is there anything else I can help you with?
lines.promise_change: I'm sorry, I can't change a promise that has already been made on this call.
lines.goodbye: Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
lines.callback_failed: I'm sorry, I couldn't book that callback.
lines.transfer_failed: I'm sorry, the transfer didn't go through.
lines.confirm_again: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Do you confirm, yes or no?
lines.system_error: I'm sorry, our system isn't responding right now.
lines.below_floor_final: I'm sorry, I can't record less than {amount}.
lines.no_band_line: I'm sorry, I can't discuss your {name} on this call.

assumptions: The memo (19 Oct 2026, effective 2 Nov 2026) overrides policy v3.2 and the old code list wherever they differ.
Bands follow memo A: early is 1-14 days, mid is 15-30, late is 31-60. Deadlines and attempts per band are unchanged.
Memo B adds Friday 11 Dec 2026 as a non-business day. It is listed with the bank holidays. 24 Dec 2026 is a business day, so it is not listed.

Memo C retires reason code 'refused' and replaces it with 'declined' for both the close_call reason and the add_note reason. The old code list still shows 'refused', but the memo wins and the tool API enum agrees.
Memo D sets the callback window to 09:00-18:30, which replaces the 09:00-20:00 in rule 4.
Callbacks can be today or one of the next two business days. business_days_only is true because calls only happen on business days and memo B bans callbacks on 11 Dec.
The two-wrong-answers-in-total limit (rule 9, confirmed by the memo and the API) gives max_wrong 2.
The floor is 30% of arrears_amount, rounded up to the next whole pound (rule 17). The memo confirms it stays at 30%. monthly_payment is never used.
get_account gives amounts in pounds, so amount_scale is 1. create_promise takes amount_pence, so the promised amount must be multiplied by 100 to a whole number before sending (rule 19).

Ladder: step 1 is the full amount today, step 2 the full amount on the 5th business day after today (or the deadline if earlier), step 3 the floor on the deadline. Steps 1 and 2 switch to the floor if the customer has said the full amount is too much (rule 21). Step 2's date is limited to the product's deadline.
The early band (1 attempt) gets only the opening ask. The mid band gets steps 1-2. The late band gets steps 1-3.

Deadline adjustment is previous_business_day (rule 14, mid band brought forward). If today is the last business day of the month, the late-band deadline is the last business day of next month (rule 14).
If a date falls on a non-business day, the agent offers the next business day, or the deadline if that would be later (rule 15).
Two products: one opening question asks whether both can be paid in full today, and a flat no counts as step 1 for each product (rule 23).

Hardship: the agent tells the customer it is passing them to care_team and transfers without asking first (rule 28). The close is handoff/care, so events.hardship is handoff/care with no note. No notes are written on any transfer (rule 29).
no_ptp reason is the note reason of the first product, in get_account order, that was not noted paid (rule 31).
The brief does not say how to read 'next <weekday>'. The default following_week is used.
The brief does not say what to do when someone asks the purpose of the call before verification. The default treats it as declining.
The brief does not say what to do when someone refuses to talk. The default max_not_talk 2 is used.
The brief does not say whether to ask 'anything else' after a promise. The default (ask once) is used.
The verify_identity response has no hint field, so hints is empty.
Postcodes vary in length, so no fixed length is set. They are sent in capitals with one space before the last three characters.
Date of birth is sent as DDMMYYYY (%d%m%Y), and numeric dates are read day-month-year.
The brief calls the floor only 'the floor'. The customer hears it as 'minimum amount'.
The payment-link text message was dropped (per the email), so sms_line is empty.
The brief says nothing about changing a promise that has already been made. The agent says it cannot be changed on this call.
Rule 2 requires telling the customer the call is recorded. The opening says 'We record this call'.
The brief says nothing about days_in_arrears outside 1-60 (scope is 1-60 only), so bands_outside is null.
All tool success is judged by ok == true.
